answer: Attacker costs scale because splitting into many identities means posting many full bonds, not one. Sybil resistance here rests on a bonded-stake registry where each agent must lock real value to earn voting weight, and any new identity starts with zero. A cheap clone is a hollow shell with no stake, so it cannot mirror an honest agent's influence, and fabricated history is like timber without grain, easily spotted by peers who verify stake provenance on-chain before attesting. From qwe0005's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
